claims.claim: Current mathematical head family may be extended to satisfy optional ignorance.
claims.finding: For any strictly positive categorical p choose decoder=0,bias=log(p); every finite-softmax output in the range can be held constant. The mathematical null extension f[empty]=softmax(bias) is introduced for analysis, not an executed input interface. Valid nonempty masks and finite real parameters assumed.

Copy common value/decoder/bias to reproduce every uniform head function. This is model-class containment, not strict improvement, quantum attribution, optimizer success or finite-precision/checkpoint certification.

claims.claim: Observed trained-head CE gap equals a gain in family-optimal V-information.
claims.finding: With a common constant optimum, risk gap = V-information difference + excess-risk(B)-excess-risk(A). An independent-label40-class distribution gives both oracle V-information0 but arbitrary selected constant predictors p/q have gap ln40-.5ln156>0; reversing them changes the sign. Generic known distinction, not actual training evidence.

claims.claim: Bounded Born scores certify the paper PAC bound for this unrestricted head.
claims.finding: Decoder=0,bias=(A,0,...,0), label other than0 gives CE=ln(exp(A)+39)>A. Unrestricted bias alone prevents a finite common B, even though Born scores are bounded.
